director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum ek poore ke barabar hisse karke bhinn banayenge. Chalo, shuru karein?
pata nahi

Chalo, main batati hoon. Ghar mein ek roti 4 bachchon mein barabar baantni hai. Har bachche ke hisse ka ek pakka naam hota hai. Yeh roti 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Rang wala ek hissa poori roti ka 1/4 hai, ek-chauthaai. Poore ke barabar hisson mein se aisa ek hissa fractional unit kehlata hai. Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Bhinn ka neeche wala number batata hai ki poora kitne barabar hisson mein bata. Bagal wali roti ke hisse gino. 8 barabar hisson wali roti ka ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao
Theek hai, yahi baat seedhe tareeke se kehti hoon. Bagal wali roti bhi utni hi badi hai, par uske 8 barabar hisse kiye hain. Uska ek hissa poori roti ka kaunsa bhinn hai?
director.card: Bagal wali roti bhi utni hi badi hai, par uske 8 barabar hisse kiye hain. Uska ek hissa poori roti ka kaunsa bhinn hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, yahi baat seedhe tareeke se kehti hoon.

director.text: 1/8 hai na

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki roti ke 8 barabar hisse, aur yeh unmein se ek. Dono pattiyan 12 cm ki hain aur dono ke 3 hisse hain. A ke teeno hisse 4 cm ke hain, barabar, toh har hissa 1/3 hai. B ke hisse 6, 3 aur 3 cm ke hain, toh unmein se koi bhi 1/3 nahi. Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?
director.card: Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?

director.text: pata nahi
Teeno hisse barabar honge aur milkar poori patti banayenge. Socho, kaunsi lambai teen baar jodne se 15 cm banti hai. 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisson mein har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?
director.card: Ab ek 15 cm ki patti ke 3 barabar hisse karne hain. Har hissa kitne cm ka hoga?

director.text: 5 centimetres

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, teen barabar hisse milkar poori 15 cm ki patti. Ribbon P 20 cm ki hai, toh uska 1/2 10 cm hai. Ribbon Q 12 cm ki hai, toh uska 1/2 sirf 6 cm hai. Naam ek hai, 1/2, par poora alag hai, isliye lambai alag hai. Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?
director.card: Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: mujhe lagta hai 2 cm

Haan, bilkul theek: P ka 1/4 20 ÷ 4 = 5 cm, Q ka 12 ÷ 4 = 3 cm, toh fark 2 cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Dadi ne 30 cm lamba ganna barabar hisson mein kaata, aur har hissa 6 cm ka hai. Ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa bhinn hai? Bhinn batane se pehle kya pata karna hoga?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao

Ab ek hi poore ko kam ya zyada hisson mein baant kar hisse milayenge. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan

Yeh do pattiyan bilkul ek jaisi hain. Pehli 3 barabar hisson mein bati hai, doosri 6 mein. 6 bada number hai, phir bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai, kyunki wahi patti zyada hisson mein bati. Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

director.text: 3 hisse
3 hisse sahi nahi hai. Pehli patti ke ek hisse ke theek neeche dekho, aur gino doosri patti ke kitne hisse us jagah mein aate hain. Kitne 1/6 hisse milkar ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

director.text: 0 hisse

Nahi, 0 hisse theek nahi. Socho ek pizza 3 dost baantein aur bilkul waisa pizza 6 dost. 6 doston mein har ek ka hissa chhota hoga, kyunki pizza wahi hai. Board par bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai. Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

Jitne zyada dost, har dost ka hissa utna chhota. In pattiyon ke 1/3, 1/10 aur 1/5 hisson ko sabse chhote se sabse bade tak kram mein lagao.

Paani ki ek botal 2 doston mein baanto ya 8 mein. 8 doston ke gilaas mein kam paani aata hai, kyunki botal wahi hai. Do ek jitni lambi dor hain: ek 6 barabar hisson mein kati, doosri 9 mein. Kis dor ka ek hissa chhota hai?
